events.title: 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 appoint 뤼트 휠릿 as their new manager, the day before his 36th birthday. The first month of the league season ends with newly promoted 찰턴 애슬레틱 top of the Premier League, but the end-of-month table has little significance as only two games have been played so far. 선덜랜드 head the race for a place in next season's Premier League as Division One leaders, with 울버햄프턴 원더러스 in second place. Hopes are high of a successful season for Midlands clubs as 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 are third and 버밍엄 시티 stand fourth. 노리치 시티 , rebuilding under new manager 브루스 리옥 occupy fifth, while the top six is completed by a 왓퍼드 side who are searching for a second successive promotion. Just outside the playoff zone are Bury , whose excellent start to the season has sparked speculation that they might match 스완지 시티 and 윔블던's record of three promotions in four seasons.

events.title: Ron Reeves, a 55-year-old steward, is killed outside Highfield Road stadium after being crushed by the 아스널 team coach just before a game with 코번트리 시티. The month ends with 애스턴 빌라 still top, a point ahead of second placed 맨체스터 유나이티드, while 아스널 are close behind in third place. A wide gap is beginning to open up between the top three and the rest of the division, with 리버풀, 미들즈브러, 첼시, 레스터 시티 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 putting up the nearest competition. 사우샘프턴, still only with one win to their name, occupy bottom place and are joined in the relegation zone by 코번트리 시티 and 노팅엄 포리스트. 선덜랜드 and 허더즈필드 타운 continue to head the race for Premier League football, with the top six being completed by 버밍엄 시티, 입스위치 타운 , 왓퍼드 and 노리치 시티. 그림즈비 타운 (eighth) have emerged as surprise contenders for a second successive promotion, but Bury's challenge is falling away and they now occupy 15th place. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 fare little better after their dismal start to the season, now occupying 12th place.

events.title: April draws to a close with 아스널 now leading the Premier League, but 맨체스터 유나이티드 are a point behind with a game in hand. 첼시 and 리즈 유나이티드 remain in distant contention, while the final European place is being contested by 애스턴 빌라, 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 미들즈브러, 더비 카운티, 리버풀 and 레스터 시티. 노팅엄 포리스트's inevitable relegation has now been confirmed, with 사우샘프턴, 찰턴 애슬레틱, 블랙번 로버스, 코번트리 시티, 에버턴 and 셰필드 웬즈데이 all in the battle of avoid going down as well. 선덜랜드 are definitely in the Premier League next season, as champions of Division One. 브래드퍼드 시티 and 입스위치 타운 are level on points in the race for second place, with 버밍엄 시티 now the only team who can catch either of them. 볼턴 원더러스 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 complete the top six, but 왓퍼드 are pushing hard for a playoff place.

events.title: 선덜랜드's 2–1 win over 버밍엄 시티 on the final day of the Division One season has given them an English league record of 105 points this season. They will be joined in the elite next season by 브래드퍼드 시티, whose second-place finish has given them top flight football for the first time since 1922. 입스위치 타운, 버밍엄 시티, 왓퍼드 and 볼턴 원더러스 will contest the playoffs. Meanwhile, 맨체스터 유나이티드 go back on top of the Premier League with a 1–0 win at 미들즈브러.

events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a goalless draw by former assistant manager Brian Kidd's 블랙번 로버스 at Ewood Park – a result which confirms 블랙번 로버스's relegation (just four years after being champions) and allows the title destiny to remain firmly in United's hands.

events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 clinch their fifth Premier League title in seven seasons after beating 토트넘 홋스퍼 2–1 at home on the final day of the season, rendering 아스널's 1–0 home win over 애스턴 빌라 useless. Third placed 첼시 beat 더비 카운티 2–1, while 리즈 유나이티드 end 데이비드 오리어리's first season in management in fourth place with a 2–2 draw at Coventry. 웨스트햄 유나이티드's 4–0 home win over 미들즈브러 secures them a fifth-place finish and a place in the 1999–2000 UEFA Cup , their highest finish for 13 years and their first European campaign in 19 years. The last relegation place goes to 찰턴 애슬레틱, who lose 1–0 at home to 12th placed 셰필드 웬즈데이, while 사우샘프턴 confirm their survival with a 2–0 win over 에버턴.

In four days' time, they will be competing in the European Cup final to challenge for a unique treble.

events.text: 맨유가 바이에른에 2–1로 역전승했다. 셰링엄과 솔샤르가 추가시간에 차례로 득점하면서 유럽 정상의 주인공이 달라졌다.
